style_en: 日本のアニメ調、くっきりした主線、落ち着いた色、明るく均一な光、古墳時代の日本（みずら・衣褌・勾玉）。全話で同じ絵柄。背景は必ず真っ白
avoid_en: 文字、ロゴ、現代の建物や服、大陸風（中国風）の服、裸、血

oanamuji.desc_en: Oanamuji, the young Okuninushi, a gentle slender young god about 19 years old with kind patient eyes, clean-shaven, black hair in mizura loops beside both ears, a plain undyed hemp Kofun-period tunic with a dull brown sash and pale trousers tied below the knees with cords, a small green magatama on a cord, barefoot, carrying a huge worn cloth sack on his back

usagi.desc_en: the Hare of Inaba, a small wild Japanese hare drawn as a real animal on four legs (not humanoid, wearing nothing), with long ears, soft white fur and dark clever eyes

yasogami.desc_en: the eldest of the Yasogami brother gods, an arrogant handsome man about 30 with a sneering mouth, black hair in mizura loops, a rich crimson Kofun-period tunic with a gold sash, white trousers tied with red cords, a large magatama necklace and an ornate sword at the waist

yakami.desc_en: Yakami-hime, the princess of Inaba, a composed young woman about 20 with clear direct eyes, long black hair with the top tied in a loop, a white Kofun-period kinu tunic over a long pale-gold pleated mo skirt, a thin string of magatama beads
